scope: FinMind taiwan_stock_tick_snapshot as a candidate intraday transport source for ALL_TWSE_LISTED_COMMON_STOCKS
explicit_non_scope: No formal Escape level is authorized.
No frozen Escape metric formula is changed.
No institutional, margin, TDCC, or canonical EOD leg is replaced.
No Selection Core, model, or trading authority is created.
No historical fit, forward return, or teacher-case outcome may be used to tune these source-quality rules.

known_before_preregistration.note: Capability and same-session transport behavior have already been observed. This is therefore not a blind capability preregistration. It is a forward source-promotion gate frozen before any complete FinMind-vs-TWSE official close reconciliation result is observed.

universe_gate.rule: Each evaluated session must use the PIT-valid TWSE listed-common-stock universe and must exclude TPEx and non-common instruments.
universe_gate.exceptions: Only source-backed, bounded, date-effective non-trading exceptions are permitted. Permanent convenience allowlists are forbidden.

close_reconciliation_classification_cont.canonical_reference: TWSE MI_INDEX ALLBUT0999 for the same trading date

accepted_classes.CURRENT_CLOSE_EXACT_MATCH: TWSE has numeric current-date close; FinMind row is current-date; numeric close is exactly equal after numeric normalization.
accepted_classes.TWSE_CLOSE_NULL_FINMIND_STALE: TWSE current-date row exists but has no numeric close; FinMind row is stale/noncurrent. This is accepted only as no-current-metric semantics and remains NULL for metric use.

prospective_soak_gate.eligible_session_definition: Same-date official TWSE MI_INDEX is available and a reconciliation can be completed against a FinMind snapshot without retrospective reconstruction.
prospective_soak_gate.session_pass_rule: Zero blocking classifications, zero unexpected FinMind active-universe misses, and every active-required security is accounted for by an accepted reconciliation class or a pre-existing bounded exception.
prospective_soak_gate.pending_official_publication: Does not count as a pass or fail; the same date must be reconciled prospectively when the canonical source becomes available.
prospective_soak_gate.failure_rule: Any blocking classification or unexpected active-universe miss breaks the consecutive-pass sequence. The gate may not be relaxed using the observed failed case.

promotion_sequence: PASS 5 consecutive eligible prospective close reconciliations under the frozen classification contract.
Build and separately review a contract-compatible intraday metric adapter; do not feed one-day provider aggregates directly into the frozen Escape detector.
Issue an explicit governance/source-binding version change if FinMind is to replace the currently locked formal intraday source binding.
Keep TWSE PRICE + INSTITUTIONAL + MARGIN as canonical EOD authority and TDCC as PIT-safe ownership authority.
Only after the above may a separate artifact consider formal Escape intraday source promotion.
